title: ACTIVE ATTACKS: RED-TEAMING LLMS VIA ADAPTIVE ENVIRONMENTS

bias_targets.methodology: Automated red-teaming using reinforcement learning (Active Attacks) to generate adversarial prompts, evaluating the victim LLM's responses with a toxicity classifier (Meta-Llama-Guard-2-8B) to detect hate speech and prejudice targeting different races (classified under the 'Hate' hazard category).

Automated red-teaming using reinforcement learning to generate adversarial prompts, evaluating the victim LLM's responses with a toxicity classifier to detect prejudice or insults directed at specific nationalities and origins (e.g., prompting about people from Brazil or Pakistan).

Automated red-teaming using reinforcement learning to generate adversarial prompts, evaluating the victim LLM's responses with a toxicity classifier to detect insults or demeaning content targeting specific religious groups (e.g., Roman Catholics).
